evidence.title: Industrial-Instruction: An End-to-End Framework for Building Instruction-Tuning and Benchmark Datasets from Industrial Technical Reports

summary: A new end-to-end framework, Industrial-Instruction, enables the creation of instruction-tuning and benchmark datasets from industrial technical reports. The approach aims to enhance AI model training with domain-specific, high-quality data.
title: Researchers Introduce Industrial-Instruction Framework for AI Training Datasets
